title: Mistral Small takes the `mistral` slot
summary:
Mistral Small gained the `mistral` slot and vision support, while a project link and text API documentation got tidied up.

The `mistral` chat model changed from Mistral Nemo to Mistral Small 3.1 2503, with vision support and separate streaming and non-streaming endpoints. Related configurations added a Scaleway mapping and translated `seed` to Mistral’s `random_seed` parameter.

PrivatePollenAI’s author link now points to MMojoCoder’s GitHub profile. The app and repository links did not change.

The README no longer claims a 20-requests-per-minute per-IP limit. Unused rate-limiter code was removed; request handling did not change.

highlights.title: Mistral Small gets vision
highlights.text: The `mistral` chat model now uses Mistral Small 3.1 2503 and supports vision. Streaming is supported too. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).
